The wheel–rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by the use of Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified by the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [25].

The wheel-rail interaction forces mainly include wheel– rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by the use of Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified by the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins nonlinear model (Shen et al. 1983).
